rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriately references ICM, TE, and zona thinning, but some noted debris/darkening features may be speculative from a single image.

Integrates key factors well: young age, BMI, prior biochemical pregnancy/miscarriage, male factor, sperm motility, endometrium, and ovarian response, though AMH is unavailable and some interactions are not deeply quantified.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis adjusted downward for BMI and prior losses despite strong embryo quality; only minor overinterpretation around miscarriage significance.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including SET and avoiding routine add-on therapies; minor deviations include somewhat broad discussion of recurrent loss workup after limited losses.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, and targeted evaluation if failure/loss recurs, though some suggestions remain general rather than protocol-specific.
